subject: SIG: KMS access screenshots, rotation policy & ops runbook for Blue Ridge Biotech
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@blueridge.bio>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: SIG follow-up: KMS evidence and runbook request

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking our SIG. Blue Ridge has a couple of follow-ups from the security review: we need to validate KMS operational controls and evidence for how keys are rotated, access is logged, and what we should expect in an incident. Specifically could you provide:

- KMS key rotation policy (document we can attach to our report)
- Screenshots showing KMS key usage logs (last 90 days) and an example audit entry for a key rotate/disable action
- The ops runbook for key compromise (or incident response extract) showing steps and on-call contacts
- Any network diagram or diagram showing where keys are used (high level)

If you can share these as Drive links that would be best. Also let us know if anything needs redaction. We need to close this with our security committee by 2026-12-02.

Best,
Liam
Security Manager
Blue Ridge Biotech
security@blueridge.bio

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@blueridge.bio>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: KMS evidence and runbook request

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a small bundle for you. Initial plan:

1) Provide a Drive folder with an index (manifest) that groups policy, runbook, screenshots and diagrams.
2) Include a short recorded walkthrough (7 min) pointing at the exact console locations and log samples.
3) Redact internal IPs and on-call phone numbers; keep role-based contacts. If you need unredacted artifacts for an auditor, let us know and we'll follow the NDA request path.

Current items I uploaded to a shared folder:  
- kms-rotation-policy.pdf  (policy excerpt + version history)
- key-compromise-runbook-v2.md  (ops steps, escalation matrix)
- ops-network-diagram.png  (high-level service boundary)
- kms-access-screenshots.zip  (console screenshots + exported audit CSV)

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_kms_evidence
Walkthrough (Loom): https://www.loom.com/share/example-walkthrough-7min

I copied Diego on the console screenshots request for the exported CSV and a couple of high-res PNGs. Marissa, I'm keeping you looped for the audit manifest.

Can you confirm whether role names or email addresses need to be redacted in the audit CSV? We can provide both redacted and unredacted versions to support your internal review.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

(Attachment stubs: kms-rotation-policy.pdf, key-compromise-runbook-v2.md)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: FW: SIG follow-up: KMS evidence and runbook request

Diego — quick favor: Liam asked for KMS access screenshots and the exported audit entries for the last 90 days. Can you pull:  

- exports/audit_kms_20261124.csv (CSV with timestamp, principal, action, resource)
- high-res screenshots for rotate/disable action UI (pngs)
- a concise note on whether these entries include service-account names or just role identifiers (we need to know if PII shows up)

If you can drop them into the Drive folder linked below and add a short README about redaction steps I will send to the customer today.

Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_kms_evidence

Thanks — Priyom

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 09:03 Priyom Das wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a small bundle for you. Initial plan:
> ...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: SIG follow-up: KMS evidence and runbook request

Priyom — done. I exported the CSV and created a screenshot bundle. Notes:

- exports/audit_kms_20261124.csv (placed in Drive folder) includes principal identifiers as role names; no internal personal emails.
- kms-screenshot-rotate-01.png, kms-screenshot-audit-entry-01.png included.
- README_redaction.txt added describing the script used to remove IPs and phone numbers.

I also ran a quick validation against the rotation policy and confirmed rotation meta (last rotated: 2026-09-14). Dropped everything in the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_kms_evidence

— Diego
Platform Security Engineer
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@blueridge.bio>, security@blueridge.bio
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: KMS evidence and runbook request — delivery

Hi Liam — attaching the consolidated bundle for Blue Ridge. Thank you for the deadline; we were able to compile everything for your security committee. Summary of what's in the shared folder:

- 00_MANIFEST.md (index and checklist)
- kms-rotation-policy.pdf (policy excerpt; v1.3)
- key-compromise-runbook-v2.md (runbook redacted for personal contact info; contains role escalation matrix)
- kms-access-screenshots.zip (includes kms-screenshot-rotate-01.png, kms-screenshot-audit-entry-01.png, exports/audit_kms_20261124.csv)
- ops-network-diagram.png (annotated high-level diagram)
- README_redaction.txt (notes on what was redacted and how to request unredacted copies for audit)
- loom walkthrough (7 min): https://www.loom.com/share/example-walkthrough-7min

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_kms_evidence

A few implementation notes:
- The audit CSV uses role identifiers rather than employee emails; we have not included any phone numbers.
- Rotation cadence: policy requires 12-month rotation for customer keys; last rotation recorded 2026-09-14.
- Key compromise runbook contains the immediate mitigation steps, suggested communication templates for customers, and the escalation matrix.

If you need an unredacted CSV for your auditors, we can arrange a controlled share under mutual NDA — let me know and I'll route it through legal. Please confirm receipt and whether anything else is required before your 2026-12-02 review.

Best regards,

--
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: kms-access-screenshots.zip, ops-network-diagram.png)
